backgrounds: Single continuous location for the entire episode: a hospital/clinic waiting area just outside an ICU. The set features a row of metal-framed waiting-room bench seats with black cushioned backs, a pair of frosted-glass double doors labeled 'ICU' in the center background, muted sage-green walls, a checkerboard-pattern tile floor (cream and grey-blue squares), overhead fluorescent panel lighting, a lit vending machine stocked with snacks/drinks to the right, and a bulletin board with papers pinned to the wall on the left. Background characters (other seated/standing figures, a person in a lab coat, other suited figures on phones) populate the space but the camera stays fixed on the two foreground characters on the bench the whole time — no scene/location changes within the episode.
props: Smartphones (each main character holds one, screens lit, used for texting/dating app throughout)
Metal waiting-room bench with black cushioned seatback dividers
Illuminated vending machine with visible snack/drink rows
Wedding ring on the woman's hand
Small pearl stud earrings on the woman
Round black-framed glasses on the man
Black suit, white shirt, and tie on the man; brown knit sweater and black skirt on the woman
lighting_notes: Cool, slightly dim, desaturated fluorescent hospital lighting from overhead panels, giving flat even illumination with a greenish-grey cast typical of institutional interiors. The characters' phone screens provide small, subtle secondary light/glow on their hands and faces, reinforcing the phone-scrolling focus. Overall lighting is moody and subdued rather than bright or cheerful, matching a deadpan waiting-room tone.
color_palette: golden yellow (title card text and 'NEW EPISODE DAILY' tag)
visual_complexity_notes: The set is a single, moderately detailed but visually restrained location (waiting room) rather than a minimal blank backdrop — background characters and props (vending machine, ICU doors, bulletin board) add texture, but the camera framing and shallow depth of field keep background elements soft/blurred so focus stays locked on the two foreground characters' deadpan expressions and phone activity. This appears deliberate: a believably 'real' but low-key setting that doesn't compete with the dialogue-driven, character-focused comedy.
